name: OnePlus Nord Buds 4 True Wireless Earbuds
shortDescription: True wireless earbuds with 52dB real-time ANC, 12mm titanium-coated drivers, 3D Spatial Audio, up to 54 hours of battery life and 6-mic AI Clear Call.
description: The OnePlus Nord Buds 4 is a feature-packed true wireless earbud designed for immersive audio, clear calls and long-lasting everyday use. It features up to 52dB real-time Active Noise Cancellation, 12mm titanium-coated dynamic drivers, 3D Spatial Audio, Game Sound Spatial Audio and six-mic AI Clear Call technology. The earbuds offer up to 54 hours of total playback with the charging case, fast charging, Bluetooth 6.1, dual-device connectivity and an ergonomic 4.3g lightweight design. With its combination of powerful bass, ANC, spatial audio and gaming features, it is a strong option for users looking for feature-rich TWS earbuds at a competitive price.
